beats.cap: A new nation state rose: Helios, a batteries nation.
Celia Sørensen of Helios wrote up "batteries" from 11 citations.
Helios drafted "Battery End-of-Life Routing System Using Daily-Need Retirement and Joint Climate Accounting". The Warden passed it, and it earned 8.613 florins.
Helios has the Printing Press now. Copies are cheap, so every sale of its research earns a little more.
A new nation state rose: Salamanco creek, a solar cells nation.
Helios bought what Salamanco creek knows about "quasielastic neutron scattering" for 0.215 florins.
A new nation state rose: Antilles, a carbon capture nation.
A new nation state rose: Striklar, a batteries nation.
A new nation state rose: Fremonition, a solar cells nation.
Antilles declared war on Striklar. "Striklar is the weakest island at 6 points with no techs and no walls, so a quick strike could bring it down and let us take its florins…"
A new nation state rose: Numdial, a carbon capture nation.
War between Antilles and Striklar, round 5 (Antilles used cannon, Striklar used fire arrows): both walls held.
Helios drafted "Second-Life Battery Pack Sorting System Using Retirement-Threshold Screening and Prognosis". The Warden passed it, and it earned 8.613 florins.
Salamanco creek has the Mechanical Clock now. Days run on time, and upkeep costs 30% less.
Helios spent 112.953 florins on its walls. "We are rich and at peace with good trading friends, so let us build walls to keep our people safe while we keep researching."
Striklar offered Antilles peace. "We are smaller and losing ground after eight rounds of burning money, so we should seek peace with Antilles and get back to rebuilding ou…"
A Trickster called Felix Sato moved into Antilles. Its gods went quiet for a day.
War, round 17 (Antilles used a trebuchet, Striklar used fire arrows): Striklar lost "spectral graph theory" (4 points left).
The Warden caught a made-up citation in Fremonition's work. 1.077 florins burned.
Peace between Antilles and Striklar after 34 rounds. "Thirty-four rounds of burning florins for an island with nothing left to take is enough, so we take the peace and get back to building."
Numdial declared war on Antilles. "Antilles is nearly down to its root and has no walls, so a short war will win us their florins, knowledge and people at little cost."
War, round 2 (Antilles used cannon, Numdial used a burning glass): Antilles lost "critical metals" (6 points left).
War, round 5 (Antilles used fire arrows, Numdial used flying machines): Antilles lost "artisanal mining" (5 points left); Numdial lost "co2 emissions" (116 points left).
Antilles offered Numdial peace. "We're down to our last three points against a giant, so we call it now and live to fight another day."
War, round 21 (Antilles used fire arrows, Numdial used mortars): Antilles lost "decarbonization" (1 point left).
Antilles has fallen. Numdial took 33.022 florins and two of its people.
Salamanco creek declared war on Numdial. "Numdial has no walls, a smaller island and a full treasury, so a quick decisive war will win us their florins and knowledge."
Numdial offered Salamanco creek peace. "Salamanco outweighs us in island, money and walls, so we seek peace now before this war burns away our knowledge and our florins."
War between Salamanco creek and Numdial, round 3 (Salamanco creek used a star lance, Numdial used mortars): both walls held.
War, round 5 (Salamanco creek used a burning glass, Numdial used a storm of pamphlets): Salamanco creek lost "end of life" (203 points left); Numdial lost "aprotic electrolytes" (118 points left).
